Grenoble ( / ɡ r ə ˈ n oʊ b əl / grə- NOH -bəl ; [ 4 ] French: [ɡʁənɔbl] ⓘ ; Arpitan : Grenoblo or Grainóvol ; Occitan : Graçanòbol or Grenòble ) is the prefecture and largest city of the Isère department in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region of southeastern France. [ 5 ] It was the capital of the Dauphiné historical province and lies where the river Drac flows into the Isère at the foot of the French Alps .
